---
project: potflix
one_line: Show what PotPlayer is playing on your Discord profile with matched artwork and episode details.
stack: [Rust]
status: draft
since: 2026-10
capabilities: []
limits: []
updated: 2026-11-22
draft: true
---

PotPlayer has no built-in way to show what it is playing on Discord. Potflix reads the playing title, matches it against a provider and publishes a Rich Presence card with the artwork and details.
